splash: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original portrait artwork for the right-hand panel of My Dump Studio, a photo dump editor, and for its narrow Windows installer sidebar. Refined creative software launch artwork, a tactile editorial still life of three overlapping floating white instant-film photo prints. The foremost print contains a realistic analog street-style photograph of a stylish woman in black sunglasses in warm city light, a second print shows an orange sunset over the sea, a third has an abstract violet reflection. The stack is centered in a vivid deep purple to fuchsia to peach orange studio backdrop, with a translucent sculptural loop of photographic film orbiting through and behind it and soft optical light leaks. Aim for distinctive premium photography-campaign art, a few bold readable shapes, beautiful detail and print finish with subtle analog grain, controlled bloom, clean foreground separation. Full-bleed portrait composition about 2:3, keep the main subject within the central 65% width and 70% height so it survives center cropping to a narrow 1:2 panel. Excellent readability when reduced to 164 x 314 pixels. The left edge is dark mauve, colors warm toward the bottom. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no interface, no product logos.
